description: Check one file of SQL, Python (PySpark, a notebook's source) or YAML (a Databricks Asset Bundle, job, cluster or warehouse config) against the Field Guide's own best-practice rules, deterministically: partitioning where the guide would cluster, secrets and storage paths written into code, grants to people rather than groups, environments in table names, jobs on all-purpose clusters or without timeouts, warehouses and clusters without auto-stop, bundle targets without their modes, and the rest of the rules the chapters state. Each finding gives the line, why, the fix, the guide's passage verbatim with its section URL, and the docs.databricks.com links the guide cites for it; the result also lists the sections worth reading for this code. No model is called: weigh the findings yourself. One file per call.

code.description: The file's contents: SQL, Python (PySpark, a notebook's source) or YAML (a Databricks Asset Bundle, job, cluster or warehouse config). At most 48000 characters; review a larger file in parts.

filename.description: The file's path in the repository, e.g. resources/nightly.job.yml: used to detect the language and echoed back

lang.description: sql, python or yaml. Omit to detect it from the filename or the code.

name: review_databricks_code

build.description: The commit of the deploy that answered

code.description: The line, with any secret-looking value masked

docs.description: The docs.databricks.com links the guide cites for this advice; empty when its section cites none

index_built.description: When this deploy's index was built (ISO 8601)

ttlMs.description: How long this answer may be kept before asking again, in milliseconds

title: Review Databricks code
